name: screening-sheet
title: Internal screening sheet
for_each: select id,code as name from screenings where not cancelled order by starts

sections.title: Projection brief
sections.sql: select code,film,venue,local_start,timezone,minutes,qa_minutes,readiness,array_to_string(blockers,'; ') as issues from v_release where id=$1

sections.title: Recorded exhibition conditions
sections.sql: select c.jurisdiction,c.rights_from,c.rights_to,c.rights_evidence,c.classification_route,c.classification_label,c.classification_evidence,c.conditions from screenings s join clearances c on c.film_id=s.film_id where s.id=$1
sections.note: Check the actual licence, classification decision and local rules. This sheet grants no rights.

name: guest-itinerary
title: Private guest itinerary
for_each: select id,name from guests order by code

sections.title: Purpose and sharing review
sections.sql: select name,purpose,disclosure_basis,review_due from guests where id=$1
sections.note: Draft for the named guest and authorised coordinator only. Nothing is sent.

sections.title: Travel and commitments
sections.sql: select name,starts,ends,location,status from visits where guest_id=$1 and status<>'cancelled' order by starts
sections.note: Times in this itinerary are UTC. Convert to the destination timezone before sharing.

name: selection-record
title: Selection meeting record
for_each: select id,name from editions order by code

sections.title: Films and scores
sections.sql: select s.code,s.name,s.status,s.reviews,s.average_score,s.screenings from v_selection s join films f on f.id=s.id where f.edition_id=$1 order by s.code

sections.title: Recorded reasons
sections.sql: select f.code,n.actor,n.body,n.created_at from notes n join films f on f.id=n.film_id where f.edition_id=$1 order by n.created_at,n.id
